title: Zombie Outbreak Day 2: The Rescue Boat (1/3)

characters.Kai: src/anim/cast.py KAI; one flip-flop left after Day 1
characters.Captain Reyes: coast guard skipper, orange jacket, cap, voice [man]
characters.Dale: survivor in a grey long-sleeve, hiding a bite on his arm
characters.Fisherman: old man in a green raincoat, voice [man]

scenes.narration: If a rescue boat picks you up in an outbreak, don't relax. Count the people who won't show you their arms.
The coast guard boat pulled Kai and Tess out of the cove at seven.
Eleven survivors on deck. One captain. One locked cabin.
[kai] Could be worse. Then the engine coughed, and died.
Out of fuel. One mile offshore.
No help was coming. The radio was only static.
By noon the water cooler was empty. Eleven people. Zero water.
One man scooped up seawater to drink.
[tess] Don't! Seawater is three percent salt. It dries you out faster than drinking nothing.
So Kai pointed at the sky. Rain clouds.
They tied the deck tarp into a bowl. Let the first rain rinse off the salt. Then caught the rest.
Everyone, except one man. He kept his sleeve pulled down.
Tess had been counting. Ten people showed their arms. One wouldn't.
Then, from the locked cabin, something knocked.
Open it? Part two is next.
